verdict.rationale: The evidence documents contact records (bulk upsert, forget a contact), mentions accounts, and claims a "360° view" of customers, which points to unified record context. It never documents contact-to-company linking or a per-record activity timeline. missing for 10: documented contact–company (account) association, an explicit activity timeline on contacts and companies, depth of what the 360° view contains, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each

citations.quote: be it a deal or the owner of an account
Understand customers better with a 360° view, meet them on their preferred channels, and engage with context.
